From the kitchen

A tavern on Dionysiou Solomou

En Yevo is a Greek tavern at Dionysiou Solomou 16 in Ayia Napa: white walls, blue chairs, plants over the tables. Tables inside and outside, takeaway if you would rather eat at home, parking nearby.

Over four thousand Google reviews and a 4.8 average. On Facebook, 98 percent of 508 reviewers recommend it.
